issues.on_page: Fund Balances - End of Year 807,151; cash 560,325 + County Treasurer 11,718 + restricted 108 = 572,151 (p4)

issues.on_page: Government-wide business-type modified cash net position 80,415 -> (172,318) (p3, p1)
issues.issue: Business-type balances use the accrual proprietary statement, as the rules require. The balance_sheet Total column (p1) is modified cash and carries the utilities at (172,318) net position, so the two measures are inconsistent within the report. The Total column also holds the internal Due From/Due To Other Funds of 235,000 gross on both sides.
